def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Grid lines are rows/columns dominated by a common line color.
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if max(grid[r].count(c) for c in set(grid[r])) > w // 2]
    line_cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if max(sum(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for v in {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) > h // 2
    ]

    from collections import Counter
    line_vals = Counter()
    for r in line_rows:
        line_vals.update(grid[r])
    for c in line_cols:
        line_vals.update(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))
    line_color = line_vals.most_common(1)[0][0]

    nonline = [
        grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
        if r not in line_rows and c not in line_cols
    ]
    background = Counter(nonline).most_common(1)[0][0]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    marked = [
        (i, j)
        for i, row in enumerate(nodes)
        for j, value in enumerate(row)
        if value != line_color and value != background
    ]
    if not marked:
        return []

    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)

    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1],
                       nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1])
            if corners[0] not in (line_color, background) and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
